title: Super Vasmol 33 Kesh Kala Hair Dye

details.description: Transform your hair with Vasmol 33 Kali Mehendi, a unique Henna-based herbal formulation that blackens hair naturally. Infused with the fortifying integrity of Henna, this oil-based hair colour nourishes and conditions your locks, leaving them shiny and radiant. Its gentle, ammonia-free and peroxide-free formula ensures a safe and easy application, while the blackening effect is both effortless and long-lasting. Embrace the rich, dark hues of this hair dye and enjoy the vibrant, healthy-looking results.
details.ingredients: Henna, paraphenylene demine, sodium perborate, sodium CMC, tartaric acid, SLS powder, aamla, bhringraj, jasund, jatamansi powder and perfume.

details.description: Vasmol 100% Pure Henna is a premium, chemical-free Mehendi known for its exceptional grey coverage and natural hair care benefits. Made from high-quality henna leaves, it not only colors your hair beautifully but also nourishes and conditions it, leaving it soft and healthy. Free from ammonia and harmful chemicals, it is safe for regular use. Vasmol Pure Henna is versatile — ideal for enhancing hair color and also for creating intricate, traditional designs on hands and feet. Its rich, natural color and purity make it a trusted choice for those seeking both beauty and care in one herbal solution.

title: Vasmol Natural Henna Paste with Coffee & Beetroot

details.description: Discover the natural beauty of your hair with Vasmol Natural Henna Paste, the perfect solution for vibrant, chemical-free hair colouring. Crafted with pure henna and a blend of nourishing natural ingredients like beetroot, coffee, sage oil, and more, this ready-to-use paste delivers rich, brown colour coverage for your greys while conditioning your hair to look smooth and shiny. Free from harsh chemicals like ammonia, PPD, bleach, and synthetic colours, Vasmol Natural Henna Paste offers a hassle-free, healthy colouring experience. Trust in the power of nature to revitalise your tresses and achieve the vibrant, beautiful hair you deserve.
details.ingredients: Aqua, Lawsonia Inermis (Notural Henna) Lecf Powder, Coffee Seed Powder, Hydroxypropyl Starch Phosphate, Sodium Benzoate (and) Potossium Sorbate, Cittric Acid, Eucalyptus /Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Ol, Clove /Eugenia Caryophylus Lecf 01, DMDM Hydontoin & Methylchloroisothiazolinone & Methyisothiazolinone, Polyquatemnium-10, Neem /Azodirochta Indico Leof Extroct, Beetroot /Beta Vulgaris Root Extroct, Block Tea /Comellia Sinensis Ledf Extroct, Lemon /Citrus Medico Limonium Fruit Extract, Rosemary/Rosmorinus Officinalis Leof Oil, Sope /Salvia Coccinea Ol, Methi /Trigonela Foenum Groecum Seed Extroct
details.usageInstructions:
1. Squeeze out Heena Paste as per requirement into a bowl.
2. Stir the paste with a brush.
3. Apply all over the hair and scalp.
4. Leave it on for 2 to 3 hours.
5. Rinse off with water.

1. Apply on the scalp using a comb applicator.
